title: ABA Winter Nationals — Chandler Jaycees BMX era
summary: BMX Plus! reported that, in the early ABA years, roughly 1979–1983, the Winter Nationals was held at Chandler Jaycees BMX in Chandler.
boundary: The period source supports the event-series venue and approximate range. It does not close the Chandler Jaycees ↔ current Chandler BMX identity/site question.

title: ABA Winter Nationals — Scottsdale Jaycees Rodeo BMX Park
summary: BMX Plus! said the 1986 Winter Nationals found a new home at ABA Scottsdale Jaycees Rodeo BMX Park.
boundary: Venue/year are period-supported. Exact street location and later lineage remain open.

title: Redline Cup qualifier — Manzanita BMX Raceway
summary: A 2003 Redline Cup schedule listed Manzanita BMX Raceway in Tucson as a May 31 qualifier host.
boundary: This proves the dated qualifier listing, not the full operating span or exact historical track footprint.

title: Manzanita BMX Raceway sanctioned race
summary: An official sanctioning-body event record preserves race results from Manzanita BMX Raceway in Tucson on April 2, 2008.
boundary: The result establishes a dated occurrence. It does not establish the track's full operating chronology.

title: Olympic Day — Desert Sunset BMX
summary: USA BMX listed Desert Sunset BMX in Tucson for Olympic Day on June 23, 2013.
boundary: The official event listing does not prove uninterrupted operation from the 2003 municipal lease through 2013.

title: Olympic Day — Sara Park BMX Raceway
summary: USA BMX listed Sara Park BMX Raceway in Lake Havasu City for an Olympic Day race on June 27, 2013.
boundary: This does not establish the exact rename/continuity path to current Lake Havasu City BMX.

title: Winter Nationals — Black Mountain BMX
summary: USA BMX's 2019 Winter Nationals report documents a broad Arizona rider footprint at Black Mountain BMX.
boundary: The report supports the 2019 event ecosystem and named Arizona participation; it is not a timeless roster.

title: Gold Cup Finals Southwest — Sports Park BMX
summary: USA BMX confirmed the 2020 Gold Cup Finals South West at Sports Park BMX in Tucson for October 16–18, 2020.
boundary: The event record and surviving Lititz plaque are separate evidence objects; the artifact does not replace the official event source.

title: Route 66 Classic Nationals — High Desert 66 BMX
summary: USA BMX announced the May 7–9, 2021 Route 66 Classic Nationals at High Desert 66 BMX and identified Harry Leary as Track Operator.
boundary: The event does not by itself prove exact organizational succession to current Interstate BMX.

title: Arizona State Final Weekend — Sports Park / Chandler
summary: The 2021 Arizona State Final Weekend ran from a Sports Park State Race on September 10 to Chandler's pre-race September 11 and State Final September 12.
boundary: This is one governed weekend record linking two tracks. It is not split into one event record per rider or award.

title: Show Low BMX local race
summary: USA BMX published local race results for Show Low BMX on July 19, 2026.
boundary: This proves dated 2026 activity. It does not establish uninterrupted operation or Thunder Raceway lineage.
